# testdata/settle1g

Synthetic fixtures for the SETTLE-1g acceptance (dist/test/settle1g.sh): a rollup claim pairs
with a live specific only on shared provenance. Every person, place and object here is invented.
Three OpenClaw transcripts are distilled: the quarry one (entry A, the live specific `Mira |
found | the brass compass`), the mill one (entry B, a concept) and the kiln one (entry C, a second
live specific `Mira | found | a silver thimble`, dated earlier, so both stay live). `rollup.md` is
the rollup the stand-in model writes; `prior-rollup.md` is a rollup that superseded entry A.
`@AS_OF@`, `@A@`, `@B@`, `@C@`, `@ID_A@`, `@SOURCE@` and `@VALUE@` are filled in by the test.
